Definition
[Normalized flow] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0125 1. Definition 5.10\group normalized-ricci-flow

A solution $g(t)$ of the normalized Ricci flow on a surface is a smooth family of metrics satisfying \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}g=(r-R)g. \]
